Submissions must not exceed 10 pages for the main text, including all figures, tables, appendices, etc. Up to two additional pages containing ONLY references are permitted. All submissions should use the official ACM Primary Article Template. Deviating from the ACM formatting instructions may lead to a desk rejection.
